constant_prediction_policy: Delta Pearson undefined; constant ranking precision@20 undefined; AP of constant scores equals reference prevalence
guide_coverage: Observed distinct sgID_AB assignment strings per target, not independently randomized guides or biological replicates; small multi-assignment subgroups have explicit support counts

uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap samples of target/intervention groups; shared controls and unknown biological replicates limit interpretation; no cell bootstrap
failure_or_limitations: Conditional on this experimental population; does not establish biological replicate reproducibility
